        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END AS loan_size_category,
    COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans

    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY 
    d.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'

sql:
SELECT 
    (SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans)) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            d.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ) AS subquery;

FROM

        SELECT 
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            d.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    );

SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS percentage_good_loans,
    overall_average_percentage,
    (percentage_good_loans - overall_average_percentage) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            d.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            d.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ) AS region_data,
    (SELECT 
        (SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans)) AS overall_average_percentage
     FROM 
        (
            SELECT 
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
                SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
            FROM 
                loan l
            JOIN 
                account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
            JOIN 
                district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                l.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                d.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ) AS subquery
    ) AS overall_data;

    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS percentage_good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) - 46.885245901639344 AS comparison_to_average
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            d.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'

                ELSE 'Large'

            COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
        FROM 
            loan l

            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN

            l.amount < 100000

            CASE

                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ) AS subquery;

        (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage

            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans,

            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

            district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
         WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            d.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END)
    );

            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,

            client c

)

                ELSE 'Large'
            END)
    );

WITH LatestLabResults AS (
    SELECT 
        Patient.ID, 
        Laboratory.UA, 
        Patient.SEX,
        Laboratory.Date AS LabDate
    FROM 
        Patient
    JOIN 
        Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

)

    ID, 
    UA, 
    SEX
FROM 
    LatestLabResults

SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            c.client_id,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
            d.A11 AS average_salary
        FROM 
            client c
        JOIN 
            district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE 
            c.gender = 'F'
    )

    AVG(good_loan_percentage) AS overall_average_percentage

    (SELECT 
        (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            d.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
         FROM 
            loan l
         JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
         JOIN 
            district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
         WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            d.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END)
    );

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS percentage_good_loans,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            d.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            d.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ) AS region_data,
    (
        SELECT 
            (SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans)) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            (
                SELECT 
                    COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
                FROM 
                    loan l
                JOIN 
                    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
                JOIN 
                    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
                WHERE 
                    l.amount < 100000
                GROUP BY 
                    d.A2,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                        ELSE 'Large'
                    END
            ) AS subquery
    ) AS overall_data;

        Patient.ID, 
        Laboratory.UA, 
        Patient.SEX,
        Laboratory.Date AS LabDate

        Patient

        Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

)

sql:
SELECT 
    d.A2 AS region,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END AS loan_size_category,
    COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS good_loan_percentage
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    l.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    d.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'

    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,

        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END

    region, loan_size_category;

        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'

sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(UA) AS "Average UA Index"
FROM 
    (
        WITH LatestLabResults AS (
            SELECT 
                Patient.ID, 
                Laboratory.UA, 
                Patient.SEX,
                Laboratory.Date AS LabDate
            FROM 
                Patient
            JOIN 
                Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
            QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Patient.ID ORDER BY Laboratory.Date DESC) = 1
        )
        SELECT 
            ID, 
            UA, 
            SEX
        FROM 
            LatestLabResults
        WHERE 
            (SEX = 'M' AND UA < 8.0) OR (SEX = 'F' AND UA < 6.5)
    ) AS NormalUA;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS percentage_good_loans,
    overall_average_percentage,
    (percentage_good_loans - overall_average_percentage) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            d.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            d.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ) AS region_data,
    (SELECT 
        (SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans)) AS overall_average_percentage
     FROM 
        (
            SELECT 
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
                SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
            FROM 
                loan l
            JOIN 
                account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
            JOIN 
                district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                l.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                d.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ) AS subquery
    ) AS overall_data;

    (SELECT

        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'

            ELSE 'Large'

        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans

        loan l

     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    ROUND(percentage_good_loans, 2) AS percentage_good_loans,
    ROUND(overall_average_percentage, 2) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            d.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            d.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ) AS region_data,
    (
        SELECT 
            (SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans)) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            (
                SELECT 
                    COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
                FROM 
                    loan l
                JOIN 
                    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
                JOIN 
                    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
                WHERE 
                    l.amount < 100000
                GROUP BY 
                    d.A2,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                        ELSE 'Large'
                    END
            ) AS subquery
    ) AS overall_data
ORDER BY 
    region,
    loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    total_loans,
    good_loans,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

            SELECT

                Laboratory.UA, 
                Patient.SEX,
                Laboratory.Date AS LabDate
            FROM

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage, (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference FROM (SELECT d.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount < 100000 GROUP BY d.A2, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage, (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference FROM (SELECT d.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount < 100000 GROUP BY d.A2, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage, (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference FROM (SELECT d.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount < 100000 GROUP BY d.A2, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

        SELECT

            Laboratory.UA,

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage, (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference FROM (SELECT d.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount < 100000 GROUP BY d.A2, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference

     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000

        d.A2,
        CASE

            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage,
    (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans) AS good_loan_percentage, (good_loans * 100.0 / total_loans - 47.931819280231636) AS performance_difference FROM (SELECT d.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.amount < 100000 GROUP BY d.A2, CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

WITH loan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
)
SELECT 
    SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    loan_data;

WITH loan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
)
SELECT 
    SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    loan_data;

WITH loan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
)
SELECT 
    SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    loan_data;

sql:
WITH loan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        d.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
)
SELECT 
    SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    loan_data;

    SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l
     JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
     JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
     WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        d.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END);

    SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
     FROM 
        loan l

        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

        l.amount < 100000

            WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'

        END);

    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
) AS subquery

    SELECT 
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(atom_id, '_', 1)) AS base_molecule_id
    FROM connected
),
carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT 
        base_molecule_ids.base_molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS atom_count
    FROM base_molecule_ids
    JOIN molecule ON base_molecule_ids.base_molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY base_molecule_ids.base_molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    base_molecule_id AS molecule_id,
    atom_count
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
ORDER BY atom_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

    SELECT 
        SUM(Charter) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS HighFRPMCount,

        (colusa.TotalEnrollment::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalEnrollment) AS EnrollmentRatio

        colusa, humboldt
)

sql:
WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
fluorine_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN molecule.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_without_fluorine
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
),
bond_strength AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '=' THEN 2
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '#' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END) AS avg_bond_strength
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
avg_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_bonds
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    (carcinogenic_without_fluorine * 100.0 / total_carcinogenic_molecules) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    AVG(avg_bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
JOIN fluorine_analysis ON TRUE
JOIN avg_bonds ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = avg_bonds.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = bond_strength.molecule_id;

    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'

GROUP BY 
    d.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
fluorine_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN molecule.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_without_fluorine
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
),
bond_strength AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '=' THEN 2
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '#' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END) AS avg_bond_strength
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
avg_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_bonds
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    (carcinogenic_without_fluorine * 100.0 / total_carcinogenic_molecules) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    AVG(avg_bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
JOIN fluorine_analysis ON TRUE
JOIN avg_bonds ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = avg_bonds.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = bond_strength.molecule_id;

sql:
SELECT 
    d.A2 AS region,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END AS loan_size_category,
    COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS good_loan_percentage,
    46.885245901639344 AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    l.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    d.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
fluorine_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN molecule.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_without_fluorine
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
),
bond_strength AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '=' THEN 2
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '#' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END) AS avg_bond_strength
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
avg_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_bonds
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    (carcinogenic_without_fluorine * 100.0 / total_carcinogenic_molecules) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    AVG(avg_bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
JOIN fluorine_analysis ON TRUE
JOIN avg_bonds ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = avg_bonds.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = bond_strength.molecule_id;

    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'

    COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS good_loan_percentage,
    46.885245901639344 AS overall_average_percentage

    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

GROUP BY 
    d.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

WITH colusa AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Charter) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SELECT SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Colusa') AS TotalFreeMeals,
        (SELECT SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Colusa') AS TotalEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    WHERE 
        County = 'Colusa'
),
humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Charter) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SELECT SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Humboldt') AS TotalFreeMeals,
        (SELECT SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Humboldt') AS TotalEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    WHERE 
        County = 'Humboldt'
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        (colusa.TotalSchools::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalSchools) AS SchoolRatio,
        (colusa.TotalCharterSchools::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalCharterSchools) AS CharterSchoolRatio,
        (colusa.HighFRPMCount::FLOAT / humboldt.HighFRPMCount) AS HighFRPMRatio,
        (colusa.TotalFreeMeals::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalFreeMeals) AS FreeMealRatio,
        (colusa.TotalEnrollment::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalEnrollment) AS EnrollmentRatio
    FROM 
        colusa, humboldt
)
SELECT * FROM ratios;

sql:
WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
fluorine_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN molecule.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_without_fluorine
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
),
bond_strength AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '=' THEN 2
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '#' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END) AS avg_bond_strength
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
avg_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_bonds
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    (carcinogenic_without_fluorine * 100.0 / total_carcinogenic_molecules) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    AVG(avg_bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
JOIN fluorine_analysis ON TRUE
JOIN avg_bonds ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = avg_bonds.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = bond_strength.molecule_id;

sql:
SELECT 
    d.A2 AS region,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END AS loan_size_category,
    COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS good_loan_percentage,
    46.885245901639344 AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    l.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    d.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
